oil.when: 2015–2018 C-Class (sedan and coupe) with the ASSYST PLUS service display
steps: Have the oil, filter and scheduled service done first; the reminder is tied to the service actually being carried out.
The owner's manual for these years gives no driver reset. It says the workshop that does the service resets the ASSYST PLUS service display afterward.

To see when the next service is due: switch the ignition on, use the steering wheel buttons to open the menu list, choose Service, then ASSYST PLUS. The due date shows in the instrument cluster display.
If the service display was reset by mistake, the manual says a qualified workshop can correct it.
oil.note: A service message on the cluster can be hidden with the OK or back button on the steering wheel, but it comes back until the service is entered.

tpms.when: 2015–2018 with the tire pressure monitor that shows each tire's pressure in the cluster
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the tire and loading sticker in the driver's door opening (or the table inside the fuel filler flap).
Switch the ignition on (key in position 2) and stay parked.
Use the steering wheel buttons to open the menu list, choose Service and press OK.
Choose Tire Pressure and press OK. The current pressures show, or a message that they will appear after a few minutes of driving.
Press the down arrow button. The display asks whether to use the current pressures as the new reference values.
Press OK to confirm. The display shows that the tire pressure monitor has restarted.
Drive for a few minutes. The car checks the pressures and stores them as the new reference.
tpms.note: If the tire warning lamp flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the monitor itself has a fault, and a restart will not clear it.

tpms.when: 2015–2018 cars whose display reads Run Flat Indicator (pressure loss warning, no individual pressures)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the tire and loading sticker in the driver's door opening.
Switch the ignition on (key in position 2) and stay parked.
Use the steering wheel buttons to open the menu list, choose Service and press OK.
Choose Tire Pressure and press OK. The display reads Run Flat Indicator Active, Press OK to Restart.
Press OK. When asked whether the tire pressure is now OK, choose Yes and press OK.
The display confirms the run flat indicator has restarted. It finishes learning the tires while you drive.
tpms.note: If the tire pressure light flashes for about a minute when you start the car and then stays on, the warning system itself has a fault. A reset won't fix it; have it checked.

tpms.when: 2010–2011 C-Class (US Advanced TPMS; the display reads Run Flat Indicator)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the tire and loading sticker in the driver's door opening.
Switch the ignition on and stay parked.
Use the arrow buttons on the steering wheel to reach the Service menu, then the up and down arrows to choose Tire Pressure.
Press OK. The display reads Run Flat Indicator Active, Press OK to Restart.
Press OK. When asked whether the tire pressure is now OK, choose Yes with the arrow buttons and press OK.
The display confirms the run flat indicator has restarted.
tpms.note: Checked in the 2010 and 2011 owner's manuals. If the yellow tire lamp flashes for about 60 seconds and then stays on, the system has a fault that a restart will not fix.

tpms.when: 2008 C-Class with the Tire Pressure entry in the Service menu
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the sticker on the driver's door pillar (or inside the fuel filler flap).
Switch the ignition on and stay parked.
Use the arrow buttons on the steering wheel to reach the Service menu.
Use the up and down arrows to highlight Tire Pressure and press OK. The display reads Tire Pressure Monitor Active and a tone sounds.
Press OK again. When asked whether to restart the tire pressure monitor, choose Yes and confirm.
tpms.note: The manual asks for a restart after every pressure change, including changes for a heavier load. If the tire pressure light flashes for about a minute when you start the car and then stays on, the warning system itself has a fault. A reset won't fix it; have it checked.

notes: For these C-Class years the owner's manuals say the workshop resets the ASSYST PLUS service reminder after the service, so no driver steps are given for it.
